meta.description: Thematic tags linking verses to contemporary themes
meta.instructions: Themes are curated tags that connect classical tafsir to contemporary ethical/philosophical inquiry. Each verse can have multiple themes. Themes are presented as user-selectable filters in the Explore view.
meta.note: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED for Al-Fatihah (7 verses) to exercise the Explore/themes layer in the UI. These theme labels/descriptions are demo content written to demonstrate the rendering — NOT sourced from any scholarly edition. Replace with user-provided curated material before treating as real. Full coverage populates as content is curated.

themes.description: Opening every act in the name of God — the discipline of niyyah (intention) in daily life.
All praise to God, Lord of the worlds — grounding gratitude as the foundational human posture.
Ar-Rahman and Ar-Raheem — mercy as both universal and specific; basis of the ethics of compassion.
Master of the Day of Judgment — moral accountability and living with the end in mind.
You alone we worship, You alone we ask for help — the pairing of devotion and trust in everyday reliance.
Guide us to the straight path — seeking ongoing moral and spiritual direction.
The path of those blessed, not the astray — community, identity, and avoiding extremes.
